text: Sequential assessment 2026-09-12: retain P1 end-to-end performance qualification, separate from PHRF-14 scientific claims. Current provider handoff records banded microbenchmarks but explicitly leaves TrialBanded and B0 runtime checkpoint outstanding; those timings cannot fill C0/B0 application workload cells. Preserve frozen host/workload/runtime/source receipts, absolute and ratio targets, complete preparation/pooling/certification/IO counters, peak memory and JVM/JS evidence. Count setup amortization and all fallback/readout work; kernel-only timing or an operation estimate is not total throughput. Keep unmet targets visible without weakened numerical tolerances. PHRF-07 owns the earlier finite-state go/no-go checkpoint; this issue does not reopen finite-state by default. No new benchmark was run in this assessment.
